title: Fuobe DoP · camera motions and effects with LoRAs
description: Generated by scripts/eval/gen-cases.mjs from the research files; edit the generator, not this file. Every motion and effect the research gives a LoRA (§7.2), on your start frame (local/dop/start.png, plus local/dop/end.png for transitions; a photo of a person on a bridge matches the prompt), on the Original that runs it: Fuobe DoP (Wan 2.2 on your GPU, fal's Wan 2.2 LoRA endpoint in the cloud), Fuobe DoP · LTX for the LTX-2.3 LoRAs, the open LTX-2.5 graph for the LTX-2.5 ones. Variants: the catalog preset as it ships (the map v2), its prompt without LoRAs (preset strength 0), the research's LoRAs at their listed strengths sent by the harness (the same request as the catalog's until the strengths are tuned), and the preset's words on a partner model (Kling 2.5 Turbo). Not in the catalog yet: none.
